     ```c
     I915_WRITE(l3_offset, vgpu_vreg(vgpu, offset));
     ```

     ```c
     I915_WRITE(l3_offset, vgpu_vreg(vgpu, l3_offset));
     ```
   - This change corrects the offset used when loading the RCS specific memory object cache (MOCS).

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `render.c` addresses a bug related to the incorrect offset when loading the RCS specific MOCS. The previous implementation used an incorrect variable (`offset`), which likely led to improper memory access or configuration. The fix ensures that the correct `l3_offset` is used, thereby aligning with the intended functionality of the vGPU context switch as referenced in the fix tag. This change is crucial for the proper operation of the graphics virtualization technology (GVT) in the Intel graphics driver.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by using an incorrect variable (`offset`) when writing to the `l3_offset` register, which resulted in the wrong memory address being accessed for loading the RCS specific MOCS. This incorrect offset could lead to improper configuration of the memory object cache, affecting the functionality of the vGPU context switch.
        
        Commit message:
        drm/i915/gvt: fix wrong offset when loading RCS mocs

Fix the wrong offset of the RCS specific mocs

Fixes: 178657139307 ("drm/i915/gvt: vGPU context switch")

Signed-off-by: Chuanxiao Dong <chuanxiao.dong@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Zhenyu Wang <zhenyuw@linux.intel.com>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gvt/render.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gvt/render.c
index 95ee091ce085..0beb83563b08 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gvt/render.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gvt/render.c
@@ -207,7 +207,7 @@ static void load_mocs(struct intel_vgpu *vgpu, int ring_id)
 		l3_offset.reg = 0xb020;
 		for (i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
 			gen9_render_mocs_L3[i] = I915_READ(l3_offset);
-			I915_WRITE(l3_offset, vgpu_vreg(vgpu, offset));
+			I915_WRITE(l3_offset, vgpu_vreg(vgpu, l3_offset));
 			POSTING_READ(l3_offset);
 			l3_offset.reg += 4;
 		}
--
